key_insight: DARE-bench provides a process-aware benchmark that measures both modeling accuracy and instruction/process fidelity of LLMs on multi-step data science tasks, using carefully labeled examples and metrics that capture adherence to requested workflows.
problem_solved: Existing LLM benchmarks for data science miss workflow/process fidelity and lack accurately labeled training/evaluation data; DARE-bench fills both gaps by standardizing multi-step evaluation and supplying high-quality labels to judge instruction adherence and modeling correctness.
method: Curate multi-step data science tasks that reflect real ML workflows (data prep, modeling decisions, evaluation, interpretation).
Annotate ground-truth steps and outcomes to enable process-aware scoring (instruction adherence + modeling correctness).
Define automatic and human-evaluated metrics for instruction fidelity, step-level correctness, and end-task performance to compare LLM outputs.
impact: Enables practitioners and researchers to quantify how well LLMs follow instructions and execute multi-step data science workflows, improving model selection, fine-tuning, and trust in AI-assisted analysis.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram showing a multi-step data science workflow with points where DARE-bench checks fidelity (data prep → modeling → evaluation → interpretation).
Bar chart comparing modeling accuracy vs instruction fidelity across multiple LLMs.
Example trace: side-by-side ground-truth step-by-step plan and an LLM-generated plan with colored highlights for correct/incorrect steps.
Dataset composition pie chart (task types, label sources: human/synthetic) and metric definitions callout.
paper_title: DARE-bench: Evaluating Modeling and Instruction Fidelity of LLMs in Data Science
paper_authors: Fan Shu, Yite Wang, Ruofan Wu, Boyi Liu, Zhewei Yao
